```{python}
import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree

import pandas as pd
import geopandas as gpd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

from rent_project.config import (
    DATA_DIRECTORY,
    PROCESSED_DIRECTORY,
    OUTPUT_DIRECTORY,
)
```

Loading data
```{python}
data = pd.read_parquet(PROCESSED_DIRECTORY / "greater_london_rents_dataset.parquet")
```

Checking data is ok

```{python}
# overall size
len(data) # 4 151 457

# number of dwellings
len(data[
    (data["is_residential_2011"] == True)
    & (data["state_2011"].eq("2") | data["state_2011"].isna())
]) # 3 450 307 dwellings in 2011

len(data[
    (data["is_residential_2021"] == True)
    & (data["state_2021"].eq("2") | data["state_2021"].isna())
]) # 3 795 583 dwellings in 2021

len(data[
    (data["is_residential_2026"] == True)
    & (data["state_2026"].eq("2") | data["state_2026"].isna())
]) # 3 956 394 dwellings in 2026

# number of private rented dwellings
len(data[data["private_rented_2011"] == True]) # 878 151 private rented in 2011
len(data[data["private_rented_2021"] == True]) # 1,174,022 private rented in 2021

# average estimated rent (not imputed)
data.groupby("est_rent_imputed")["est_rent_2011"].agg(["mean", "count"])
data.groupby("est_rent_imputed")["est_rent_2014"].agg(["mean", "count"])
data.groupby("est_rent_imputed")["est_rent_2021"].agg(["mean", "count"])
data.groupby("est_rent_imputed")["est_rent_2024"].agg(["mean", "count"])
```

Totals

```{python}
n_2011 = len(data[data["private_rented_2011"]]) # 878,151 private rented in 2011
t_2011 = data[data["private_rented_2011"]]["est_rent_2011"].sum() # £16,860,249,333 paid in 2011
t_2011 / n_2011 / 12 # average 1,600 pcm


n_2021 = len(data[data["private_rented_2021"]]) # 1,174,022 private rented in 2021
t_2021 = data[data["private_rented_2021"]]["est_rent_2021"].sum() # £28,271,600,199 paid in 2021
t_2021 / n_2021 / 12 # average 2,007 pcm

# If the same addresses were private rented in 2024, their residents would pay ...
data[data["private_rented_2021"]]["est_rent_2024"].sum() # £33,975,017,640 paid in 2024*

```

Maps

Go through the code below

```{python}
points = gpd.GeoDataFrame(
    data,
    geometry=gpd.points_from_xy(data["x_coordinate"], data["y_coordinate"]),
    crs="EPSG:27700",
)
hexagons = gpd.read_file(DATA_DIRECTORY / "raw" / "spatial-boundaries" / "Hex350_grid_GLA" / "Hex350_grid_GLA.shp").to_crs("EPSG:27700")

joined = gpd.sjoin(points, hexagons[["geometry"]], predicate="within")

# Rent only counts towards the total for privately rented properties
joined["rent_2011"] = joined["est_rent_2011"].where(joined["private_rented_2011"], 0)
joined["rent_2021"] = joined["est_rent_2021"].where(joined["private_rented_2021"], 0)

stats = joined.groupby("index_right").agg(
    n_properties=("uprn", "size"),
    n_private_rented_2011=("private_rented_2011", "sum"),
    n_private_rented_2021=("private_rented_2021", "sum"),
    t_rent_2011=("rent_2011", "sum"),
    t_rent_2021=("rent_2021", "sum"),
)
stats["t_rent_2011"].sum() # 16854830064.9876
stats["t_rent_2021"].sum() # 28258523916.6895

hexagons = hexagons.join(stats)  # hexagons with no properties get NaN

print(f"Average properties per hexagon: {hexagons['n_properties'].mean():.1f}")

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 9))
hexagons.dropna(subset=["t_rent_2021"]).plot(
    column="t_rent_2021",
    cmap="viridis",
    legend=True,
    legend_kwds={"label": "Total estimated private rent, 2021 (£)", "shrink": 0.6},
    ax=ax,
)
ax.set_title("Total private rent bill across London")
ax.set_axis_off()
plt.show()

```
